raw_text: {"competitors":[],"summary":"Alphabet's 10-K describes competition entirely in categorical terms — general purpose and vertical search engines, online advertising platforms, offline advertising media, digital content and application platforms, enterprise cloud providers, AI model developers, consumer hardware makers, digital video providers, social networks, and workspace communication tools. The only company names appearing (Google, YouTube, Waymo, X moonshot factory) are Alphabet's own businesses or products."}
